verdict.rationale: MX documents a public Platform API with a downloadable OpenAPI specification, also published in the mxenabled/openapi GitHub repo and importable into Postman. Free developer API keys with documented rotation, webhooks for event subscriptions, test institutions for sandbox work, and an llms.txt index make it drivable programmatically. The 404s on well-known OpenAPI paths only mean the spec lives elsewhere (GitHub), not that it is missing. Missing for 10: independent hands-on corroboration of driving the API end-to-end.
